World design

Varran Halls

Competing guilds seek to restart a pressure engine; expose its failing seals and choose a reversible service alliance.

Climate, lighting and weather

Mountain stronghold and cavern approaches; cool exterior light, warm workshops and low-lit ruins with readable silhouettes.

Factions

Cairn Wardens; Ashen Survey

Settlement and service placement

Forgeward hall has smith, bank, trainer, faction contact, guild registrar and shrine. Maintain service access during schedule changes.

Travel-time tests

Proposed 2-minute service circuit, 5–7-minute hall-to-descent route, and 15–25-minute optional ruin outing.

Environmental hazards

Forge hazard volumes, vertical stacked corridors and bridges. Decorative stairs must have simple collision and validated navigation.

Quest arc and consequences

Competing guilds seek to restart a pressure engine; expose its failing seals and choose a reversible service alliance.

Landmarks and discovery

Forgeward Gallery; Silent Pressure Engine; Glassward Bridge

Enemy families

Cinder mites (34–38); Fault guardians (37–41); Engine custodians (41–44)

Ore distribution

TemperedOre: mine galleries; Emberstone: rare guarded deposits

Tree distribution

PineLog: exterior supply sites; Rootwood: authored cavern roots, not arbitrary rock nodes

Fish species pools

BlindFin: cisterns; FrostChar: exterior channels

Music and ambience

Stone resonances and forge rhythm; layered ambience lowers during important dialogue.

3D art production requirements

Modular hall/interior kit, pipes, forge props, emissive materials, cavern landscape and machinery. All are acquisition/authoring tasks.

Optimization and streaming

Interior streaming may separate wings within this zone only; preserve stable site/gate IDs across sublevels and check persistence unload hooks.

Author dry clear arrival spawns outside trigger bounds. Validate compatible build/capacity/eligibility before issuing a ticket. Gate labels are not stable identity; use the listed IDs. The reciprocal pair is checked by the documentation validator.

Concrete production and test steps

  1. Create the map/definition according to the asset pages; only activate the first-phase portion now.
  2. Graybox services/roads/water with legal primitives and validate capsule/navigation before art replacement.
  3. Register stable site/gate/encounter/NPC/objective IDs through the existing schemas.
  4. Assign current-phase references in zone runtime and run two-client admission/travel tests.
  5. Upper bridge and lower hall sprites occlude correctly; no global sort-priority hacks.
  6. Unloaded interior nodes reload depleted according to backend state.
  7. Ambient schedules never remove the only repair service.
  8. Guild UI cannot mutate bank or economy facts.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
